def verify_costas(perm):
    n = len(perm)
    vectors = set()
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            dc = j - i
            dr = perm[j] - perm[i]
            if (dc, dr) in vectors:
                print(f"Duplicate vector ({dc}, {dr}) between columns {i} and {j}")
                return False
            vectors.add((dc, dr))
    print(f"All {len(vectors)} vectors are distinct")
    print(f"Expected: {n*(n-1)//2} vectors")
    return True

perm = [0, 1, 5, 3, 8, 7, 4, 6, 2]
print(f"Permutation: {perm}")
print(f"Is valid permutation: {sorted(perm) == list(range(9))}")
